title: Recovering Toric Arrangement Posets from Complement Cohomology
statement: For a central toric arrangement $A$ with layer poset $L$ and complement $M(A)$, does the cohomology algebra $H^\bullet(M(A))$ determine $L$?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Topology of Arrangements and Representation Stability (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/2, pp. 43--123](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2018/2)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The poset determines the rational cohomology algebra, and integral counterexamples show limits of the converse framework, but no result establishes that the rational algebra recovers the toric layer poset.

**Sources checked.**

- [Pagaria, Two Examples of Toric Arrangements](https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.05767)
- [Oberwolfach Report 2/2018](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2018/2)
